display.title: Authoritative Server — Avatar Purge (DELETE_ENTITY exploit)
display.description: Reproduces the inbound DELETE_ENTITY avatar-purge bug on top of the authoritative-server leaderboard: a full headless-server multiplayer scene where clicking the RED orb injects a crafted DELETE_ENTITY CRDT frame for every remote avatar entity (any PlayerIdentityData+Transform entity that is not the local player), purging them from the clicking client's ECS view. Click again to purge avatars that arrive later.
